sceneUI:
push 前 · B 只在本地
共同起点：A 本地 main: A → B (HEAD) 远程 main（origin）: A
提交 B尚未发送
网页上的仓库仍停在 A

提交先进入本地仓库；只有 push 成功后，远程分支才会前进。

push 成功 · 两边都有 A、B
本地 main: A → B (HEAD) 远程 main（origin）: A → B
提交 B 的位置
本地仓库有 B
远程 main（origin）有 B
push 做了什么把可达提交发送到远程

同步到远程只表示代码提交可见；是否部署还取决于另一个部署流程。

同事推送 C · 你的本地还没有
本地 main: A → B (HEAD) 远程 main（origin）: A → B → C
此时的提交位置
A本地 + 远程
B本地 + 远程
C · 同事的修复远程；本地未取回
git push origin main ! [rejected] main (non-fast-forward)

远程包含你没有的 C，Git 拒绝这次直接推送以免覆盖对方历史。先查看并集成 C。

pull 后 · 本地也包含同事的 C
git pull origin main 本地 main: A → B → C (HEAD) 本地远程跟踪记录 origin/main: A → B → C 远程 main（origin）: A → B → C
pull 第一步fetch 取回远程提交
pull 第二步按配置 merge / rebase 集成
这个例子线性历史可直接前进到 C

先确认 C 的内容，再按项目的 pull 配置集成；保留同事提交后，本地与远程历史一致。
sceneUI_en:
Before push · B is local only
Shared starting point: A Local main: A → B (HEAD) Remote main (origin): A
Commit BNot sent yet
Hosted repositoryStill at A

A commit first exists in the local repository. The remote branch moves only after a successful push.

Push succeeds · both sides have A and B
Local main: A → B (HEAD) Remote main (origin): A → B
Where commit B exists
Local repositoryHas B
Remote main (origin)Has B
What push doesSends reachable commits to the remote

A remote commit is available to others; deployment still depends on a separate deployment process.

A teammate pushes C · your local copy has not fetched it
Local main: A → B (HEAD) Remote main (origin): A → B → C
Where commits exist now
ALocal + remote
BLocal + remote
C · teammate's fixRemote; not local yet
git push origin main ! [rejected] main (non-fast-forward)

The remote has C, which your local branch lacks. Git rejects a direct push to protect the other commit; inspect and integrate C first.

After pull · local also includes the teammate's C
git pull origin main Local main: A → B → C (HEAD) Local tracking ref origin/main: A → B → C Remote main (origin): A → B → C
First, pullFetches remote commits
Then, pullIntegrates using configured merge / rebase
In this exampleLinear history can fast-forward to C

Review C, then integrate according to the project's pull configuration. Keeping the teammate's commit brings both histories back in sync.

parts.desc: 指向可通过网络访问的仓库；origin 只是常见名称，换名不改变仓库内容
parts.desc_en: Points to a network-accessible repository; origin is a common nickname, and renaming it does not change the repository content.

variants.when: 确认本地仓库关联了哪些远程地址
variants.when_en: See which remote addresses this repository is linked to

variants.when: 本地仓库还没有关联远程地址时
variants.when_en: When the local repository has no remote address yet

variants.when: 把本地提交送到远程仓库
variants.when_en: Send local commits to the remote repository

variants.when: 先 fetch 取回远程提交，再按配置 merge/rebase 集成本地历史
variants.when_en: Fetch remote commits, then integrate them locally using the configured behavior

use.t: 用 git remote -v 查看当前仓库关联了哪个远程地址
克隆或初始化时把远程仓库命名为 origin，后续命令直接用它
push 被拒绝时先查看远程多出的提交，再 pull 并集成后推送
clone 会复制远程当时的提交，并默认把远程命名为 origin

dont.t: 把密钥、密码或 .env 提交并推送到远程仓库
推送被拒绝时直接强推覆盖远程历史
在错误的远程地址上推送，改动进入别人的仓库
以为推送即上线：远程仓库不等于网站已经部署

lessonPractice.title: 本地有 A、B，远程另有同事提交的 C，直接 push 被拒绝。接下来怎么做？

options.label: 先查看 C 的内容，再 git pull 按项目配置集成远程历史；确认后再推送
options.feedback: 对。pull 会先 fetch，再按 merge/rebase 配置集成；先保留并查看同事的 C，再确认本地历史和改动后决定是否继续 push。

options.label: 直接 git push --force 覆盖远程的 C
options.feedback: 强推可能移除同事已推送的 C；先取回并理解对方提交，不能为了通过推送而覆盖它。

options.label: 把本地 main 改名后推到同一个远程
options.feedback: 改本地分支名不会把 C 集成进来；远程历史仍领先，推送问题仍在。

en.title: Local has A and B, while the remote also has a teammate’s C; push is rejected. What next?

options.label: Review C, then use git pull with the project’s configured integration behavior before deciding whether to push
options.feedback: Correct. Pull fetches first, then integrates using the configured merge/rebase behavior. Keep and review the teammate's C before deciding whether to push.

options.label: Run git push --force to overwrite the remote’s C
options.feedback: A force push can remove C, which the teammate already pushed. Understand and integrate that commit rather than overwriting it to make push succeed.

options.label: Rename local main and push it to the same remote
options.feedback: Renaming the local branch does not integrate C; the remote history is still ahead and the push problem remains.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先 git fetch origin，再比较本地 main 与更新后的本地远程跟踪记录 origin/main。如果远程 main（origin）多了同事的提交 C，说明它改了什么，再用 git pull 按项目配置的 merge/rebase 方式集成并处理冲突。确认 C 的改动保留、页面检查通过后再推送；说明 push 只同步到远程，不代表网站已经部署。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Run git fetch origin, then compare local main with the updated local remote-tracking reference origin/main. If remote main (origin) has a teammate’s C, explain what it changes, then run git pull using the project’s configured merge/rebase behavior and resolve any conflicts. Confirm C is preserved and the page still works before pushing; explain that push syncs to the remote but does not mean the site was deployed.

entry.demoDetail:
本地 main 与远程 main（origin）的提交历史
push 前本地 A → B；远程 A
push 成功本地与远程都有 A、B
同事推送 C 后本地 A → B；远程 main（origin）A → B → C
pull 并集成后本地与远程都有 A、B、C
git pull 先 fetch；fetch 后本地记录 origin/main 更新为 A → B → C，再按配置 merge / rebase。本例中本地 main 可快进到 C。

提交只在本地时，别人看不到；push 同步到远程也不等于网站已部署。
scenes: 本地提交 B 尚未发送到远程
同事提交 C 后，本地 push 被拒绝
pull 后按配置集成 C 并复查提交

en.demoDetail:
Commit history · local main and remote main (origin)
Before pushLocal A → B; remote A
Push succeedsBoth have A and B
Teammate pushes CLocal A → B; remote main (origin) A → B → C
After pull and integrationBoth have A, B, and C
git pull fetches first; fetch updates the local origin/main tracking reference to A → B → C, then configured merge / rebase integrates it. Here local main can fast-forward to C.

A commit is local until pushed. Syncing it to a remote does not mean the site has been deployed.

use.t: After a rejected push, review remote commits, pull to integrate them, then decide whether to push
Clone copies the remote’s current commits and commonly names that remote origin

dont.t: Commit secrets or .env files and push them
Force push over remote history after a rejection
Push to the wrong remote address
Assume pushing means the site is deployed

Both sides have A and B after push
A teammate adds C and local push is rejected
Pull integrates C according to configuration
